title: Deep Neural Variation Spaces: A Unifying Perspective on Depth and Complexity
summary: We develop a unified function space theory of deep fully connected neural networks. Functions in our spaces are defined recursively as $\ell^1$-bounded linear combinations of activated functions from preceding layers, with a dictionary of affine functions at the first layer. Unlike existing theories that are largely specialized to homogeneous activations such as the ReLU, our framework provides a meaningful notion of functional complexity for deep networks with a broad range of homogeneous and non-homogeneous activation functions commonly used in practice.
